results.name: public/sprites/rock.png is byte for byte what generate-rock-sheet.mjs writes
public/sprites/grass.png is byte for byte what generate-grass-sheet.mjs writes
public/sprites/tree.png is byte for byte what generate-tree-sheet.mjs writes
the rock sheet has `variantCount` frames of the declared size side by side
a rock frame is as wide as its one-metre tile and taller than it
every rock variant is a solid lump: at least a third of the tile, opaque
every rock variant is stone: over 90% grey, in at least 4 tones plus the dark edge
results.details: 98% in 5 tones, 99% in 5 tones, 98% in 5 tones, 98% in 5 tones

results.name: every rock variant fills the height of its tile: it starts within 3 rows of the top edge, or above it, and stands near the bottom
every rock variant casts a soft shadow on the ground
no two rock variants are the same
the grass sheet has `variantCount` tiles of the declared size side by side
every pixel of every grass tile is opaque
grass is textured all over: no 4x4 patch of any tile is one flat colour
in every grass tile between a quarter and two thirds of the pixels are blades, the rest turf
the blade share is even across tiles, so no tile stands out as lighter or darker
every grass tile is green everywhere but in its flower
flowers are the exception: on at least one tile and on fewer than one in eight
no two grass tiles are the same
